🔴Subscribe for more such analysis: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMkmYSiSQKsy0mibf5mN7qw?sub_confirmation=1

StockAdda with Janak present a list of our 10 best stocks & multibagger stocks that are corrected from their 52 week high levels to build a stock portfolio

We have also shared their support and resistance. They belong to small caps, large caps and midcaps

We are starting with Kotak Mahindra Bank share. We will do Kotak Mahindra Bank Stock Analysis. Kotak Bank stock first on our list for top stocks to buy now along with Kotak Mahindra bank share price.  We will also discuss Kotak bank share result

Next is ICICI Lombard share. ICICI Lombard stock is one of the leading private sector general insurance companies in India. 

Balkrishna Industries share focuses on specialist segments such as agricultural, construction, and industrial and we will do Balkrishna industries stock analysis in this video as well.

Next is Gujarat Gas share analysis. Gujarat Gas share is India's most significant player in City Gas Distribution. In this video, we shall see if Gujarat Gas stock is one of the best gas stocks. 

CDSL or CDSL share operates as a securities depository in India. CDSL offers services for a range of clients. CDSL share review or CDSL stock review will be done in this video to also see if CDSL can be multibagger

Affle India Stock is what we discuss next. Affle share can be one of the best AI stocks to buy 2021. 

Sumitomo Chemicals Share is known for its agrochemicals. In this video, will contemplate if Sumitomo Chemicals stock is multibagger share by Sumitomo Chemicals share analysis.

Gland Pharma Share is a Large Cap company operating in the Pharma sector. We shall look at the Gland Pharma business Model and do Gland Pharma stock review 

Metropolis share is engaged in the business of providing pathology and related healthcare services. In this discussion, we will perform Metropolis Healthcare share analysis 

Heranba Industries share is an agrochemical company. Post the recent Heranba IPO, and we will be performing Heranba stock review in this video
